articles.title: From Yelling to Smiling: Trump and Zelenskyy Team Up to Build Missiles!
articles.summary: Remember when Trump and Zelenskyy had a big fight? Now they're buddies, planning to build Patriot missiles together in Ukraine. That's a huge deal for stopping Russian attacks!

articles.title: FIFA's Big Money Plan Makes Europe's Soccer Bosses Furious!
articles.summary: FIFA wants to let private investors put money into the World Cup. But UEFA, Europe's soccer boss, says that's like selling the soul of the game. They're really mad!

articles.title: Secret Tapes: Did Joe Biden Share Classified Info and Forget Things?
articles.summary: Audio tapes from 2016–2017 show Joe Biden talking to his book writer about secret government stuff. He also sometimes couldn't remember dates. A group released them after a long court fight.
